metadata.title: Ecosystem Growth & USDaf Liquidity Initiative
metadata.description:
Ecosystem Growth & USDaf Liquidity Initiative


Requesting a one-time treasury allocation to support two complementary initiatives:

Amplifiers Program: Fund the 5-person Core Unit (Zacharias, Bhau, Guzman, JAM, Nestor) and incentivize top Amplifiers contributors for 12 months, supporting community growth, governance participation, and ecosystem integrations.

USDaf Liquidity: Deploy treasury USDC into the USDaf/USDC/USDT Curve pool for a 90-day pilot to generate yield on idle assets and deepen USDaf liquidity ahead of ampUSD.

The Kennel Club multisig will execute the liquidity deployment in coordination with Asymmetry Finance. At the end of the pilot, the DAO may exit, continue, or renew the position.

Action: Approve both initiatives and authorize the respective treasury transfers and multisig actions described above.

metadata.title: # Observatory for SPOT - Completed-Work Treasury Grant
metadata.description:
# Observatory for SPOT - Completed-Work Treasury Grant
This proposal requests a one-time 2500000 USDC grant for Observatory for SPOT, a completed, public, open-source, read-only analytics interface for the AMPL/SPOT ecosystem. It contains static Ethereum mainnet analytics covering AMPL rebase history, SPOT system state, and recorded Bill Broker state and contract quotes.

The release was completed and public before the on-chain proposal was created. The grant recognises work already done; it does not fund or request future work or services.

The Grantee is the recipient listed under Payment and executable action. The Grantee wrote this proposal and may vote For it using the addresses under Conflict disclosure.

## Completed Release

The Completed Release is identified by:

* **Repository:** [`https://github.com/msopx/observatory-for-spot`](https://github.com/msopx/observatory-for-spot)
* **Release commit:** `cb67456656941c7199699ab4e5d02137114ff1c2`
* **Release tag:** `v1.0.0`, a label for the Release commit; the commit identifier controls.
* **Release bundle:** `ipfs://bafybeicq5tu7unsdhdg7qqyrswrrttc7q3dpienicv2o7tyjae4swfpjs4`, a directory holding `observatory-for-spot-1.0.0-release.tar.gz` (SHA-256 `1c02b1d1f46dd57ac4039f3c191ef15b333deb80d696a55cd423c8c48a5ccd88`), `release-manifest.json` and `SHA256SUMS`. The bundle packages the source archive of the Release commit, `observatory-for-spot-1.0.0-source.tar.gz` (SHA-256 `7b37d7365b43811db987c64ad263dc66cc8069f6449035bbfb4bf03fc1a7738f`), together with a static build.

The contents of the Completed Release are defined solely by the Release commit, which identifies the authoritative source tree by its Git object ID, a content hash of that tree; the Release bundle is a copy identified by its content identifier and the SHA-256 sums above. Unavailability of the hosting location or of any pinned copy does not change either identification. No other branch, repository, website, account, or unpublished material forms part of the Completed Release.

## Payment and executable action



### Action 1 — Grantee payment

* **Network:** Ethereum mainnet (`chainId = 1`)
* **Target:** USDC, `0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48`
* **ETH value:** `0`
* **Call:** USDC `transfer(address,uint256)` using the recipient and amount below
* **Recipient:** `0x730C97E793f6F7c476C6AeB3E1c3fDad4714dd82`
* **Amount:** `2500000000000` USDC base units (2500000 USDC)

The "Authorized Proposal" is the on-chain proposal created from this document at the GovernorBravo contract `0x8a994C6F55Be1fD2B4d0dc3B8f8F7D4E3a2dA8F1`. Its only action is the transfer above.

"Grant Receipt Time" is the UTC timestamp of the finalized block in which Action 1 of the Authorized Proposal executes.

## Conflict disclosure

* **Addresses the Grantee may use to vote, including any address delegating voting power to them:**
  * `0x730C97E793f6F7c476C6AeB3E1c3fDad4714dd82`
  * `0x38cAaa5782BF8afF646403D567D76b016d5c24D8`



## Legal scope

If passed, this proposal authorizes only the transfer described under Payment and executable action. It is not a contract with any voter, token holder, protocol developer, foundation, company, or other person, and gives no person a right to enforce it. Statements made outside this proposal, including forum, chat, or social-media messages, form no part of it and create no representation, warranty, or obligation.

At Grant Receipt Time, the Action 1 transfer is intended to pass outright to the Grantee as a fixed retrospective grant in recognition of the Completed Release, not as cost reimbursement or payment for future work. No representation is made that it equals actual costs or market value, and no contractual repayment, clawback, or price adjustment arises merely from a later allegation of defect, nonuse, or change in valuation, or from any later protocol upgrade, contract deprecation, or unavailability of the repository.

The Completed Release is provided as-is at the Release commit identified above, with no representation or warranty that it is accurate, complete, current, secure, error-free, suitable for any purpose, compatible with other software, or continuously available. Repository and bundle materials do not create obligations or warranties under this proposal. Known limitations at the Release commit are listed in its `docs/known-limitations.md`; nothing in this proposal obliges anyone to address them. It is informational. It is not financial, investment, trading, legal, or tax advice, and it is not an offer, solicitation, or recommendation concerning any token.

No intellectual property is assigned, transferred, or exclusively licensed by this proposal. metadata.title: Separate Positive and Negative Curves and their Parameters
metadata.description:
# Separate Positive and Negative Curves and their Parameters
This proposal introduces an update to the rebase curve logic that enables separate responsiveness parameters for positive and negative rebases. It also proposes restoring the deviation threshold to 5%, reversing the reduction to 2.5% introduced in Proposal #32.

The proposed update, implemented in PR #297, allows independent control over the steepness of the positive and negative sigmoid curves—unlocking more balanced and purposeful rebase behavior.

metadata.title: Seed USDaf Ecosystem Curve LP with DAO Funds
metadata.description:
# Seed USDaf Ecosystem Curve LP with DAO Funds
Deploy **$1 million USDC** from the treasury into the **USDaf / USDC / USDT Curve pool** for a **90-day pilot**.
Goal: **(1)** earn ~8-9 % yield on idle assets, **(2)** deepen USDaf liquidity as groundwork for the upcoming ampUSD stablecoin.

If this proposal passes, the **Kennel Club multisig** will receive an allowance to deploy the $1 M USDC **in coordination with Asymmetry Finance's recommendations** into the USDaf/USDC/USDT Curve pool.

Deployment will have a duration of **90 days** from time of execution.

At the end of the 90-day pilot the DAO may:

1. revoke the allowance and exit,
2. let the position roll, or
3. renew / expand the approval for a new term.

metadata.title: FORTH Allocation for Liquidity Provisioning (2025)
metadata.description:
# FORTH Allocation for Liquidity Provisioning (2025)
# Description

Proposal to authorize the transfer of 800,000 FORTH from the DAO’s treasury in the form of a loan over 12 months.

# Specification

Ampleforth Foundation will work with market making partners to:

* Provide liquid markets across major centralized exchanges.
* Proactively guide discussions and support listings of FORTH on key exchanges
* Borrowed FORTH will be used exclusively for liquidity provision purposes. No farming, lending etc.

Ampleforth Foundation is requesting approval for a 12-month loan of 800,000 FORTH from the DAO’s treasury for liquidity provision services.

**Repayment Option:**
The Foundation agrees to return the full 800,000 FORTH loan amount to the DAO’s treasury at the end of the 12-month contract period OR exercise the repayment options below. The repayment options allows the purchase of the full 800,000 FORTH loan amount on the respective option expiry date at strike prices specified below.

* 400,000 FORTH at strike price at 120% of ATM
* 200,000 FORTH at strike price of 140% of ATM
* 200,000 FORTH at strike price of 180% of ATM

This represents a weighted average strike of 140% ATM.

The ATM price will be a 5 day TWAP starting on the date of receipt of the loan tokens, and the commencement date will be the final day of the TWAP.

Should the foundation choose to exercise its repayment option, the loan balance will be returned to the Ampleforth DAO treasury in the form of BTC, ETH or USDC assuming a USDC price of $1, and using BTC or ETH CoinGecko price at 23:59:59 UTC on the expiration date of the agreement.

# Implementation

The conclusion of [the previous agreement](https://forum.ampleforth.org/t/forth-allocation-for-liquidity-provisioning/725/1) resulted in the DAO being owned 200,000 FORTH. Should this proposal succeed, the DAO would only need to send 600,000 FORTH. In either case, it would still receive the full USDC amount owed from the previous aggrement.

If approved by governance, 600,000 FORTH will be sent from the DAO’s treasury to address:

* eth:0xc3a947372191453Dd9dB02B0852d378dCCBDf271

metadata.title: Authorize Funds for Bootstrap Liquidity Program
metadata.description:
# Authorize Funds for Bootstrap Liquidity Program 
**Background**

Bootstrap is meant to kickstart a liquidity landscape that grows SPOT and makes it more valuable for users and ecosystem projects like [Asymmetry Finance](https://www.asymmetry.finance/) and others. Bootstrap is separate from the geyser program and is intended to create a burst of energy that can quickly grow the project to the next level of sustainable use cases.

I propose to authorize the use of 4.167M AMPL to help fund [project bootstrap](https://www.spot.cash/staking/).

**Execution**

If this proposal passes, it would set an allowance for the Kennel Club multisig to deploy assets from the DAO Treasury.

* Assets would be deployed within a timeframe of 6 months from proposal execution.
* At the end of 6 months the Forth DAO has the option of ending the token approvals, letting it stand, or increasing the approvals once more.

**Summary**

Bootstrap is being kickstarted by the Ampleforth Foundation, and this AMPL allocation would help supplement the program. 4.167M AMPL accounts for roughly half of $10M of planned incentives.
